[gold]Echo[/gold]{ElemEcho:cond:=0? as no element|=1? is {water_s}Water{water_e}|=2? is {wood_s}Wood{wood_e}|=3? is {fire_s}Fire{fire_e}|=4? is {earth_s}Earth{earth_e}|=5? is {metal_s}Metal{metal_e}| is ALL [gold]Elements[/gold]}.
